title: Step 1: Project setup - Initialize Bun project, BiomeJS, test config
description: Initialize project with Bun.js, BiomeJS, and test configuration

title: Step 2: Create module skeleton and exports (src/, dist/)
description: Create src/core, src/data, src/storage, src/utils directories and placeholder modules

title: Implement CypherNG unit tests
description: Create basic unit tests for CypherNG module covering Node, Graph, QueryParser, and core functionality

title: Implement QueryExecutor.handleMatch with pattern parsing
description: Parse MATCH patterns including nodes, relationships, labels, properties. Support variable-length paths [r*..n]. Migrate logic from Cypher.js Data.Match class.

title: Implement QueryExecutor.handleCreate with pattern parsing
description: Parse CREATE patterns for nodes and relationships. Support inline property maps. Migrate logic from Cypher.js Data.Create class.

title: Implement QueryExecutor.handleMerge with find-or-create logic
description: Implement MERGE as find existing pattern or create new. Migrate logic from Cypher.js Data.Merge class.

title: Implement QueryExecutor.handleWhere with expression evaluation
description: Filter results based on WHERE conditions. Support property access, comparisons, AND/OR, IN, CONTAINS, etc.

title: Implement QueryExecutor.handleWith for pipelining
description: Carry forward variables between query parts. Support AS aliasing. Enable complex multi-part queries.

title: Implement QueryExecutor.handleUnwind for collection expansion
description: Expand collections into individual rows. Support range(), nested UNWIND.

title: Implement aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COLLECT)
description: Add aggregate function handling in ExpressionEvaluator and QueryExecutor. Support grouping.

title: Implement RETURN with expression evaluation and aliasing
description: Parse RETURN expressions, evaluate them, support AS aliasing. Handle DISTINCT.

title: Implement ORDER BY, SKIP, LIMIT clauses
description: Sort results, implement pagination with SKIP and LIMIT.

title: Implement LOAD CSV clause
description: Load CSV data from URLs. Support WITH HEADERS option. Migrate from Cypher.js.

title: Implement path functions (nodes, relationships, size, startNode, endNode)
description: Add path manipulation functions to ExpressionEvaluator.

title: Create behavioral parity tests comparing Cypher.js and CypherNG
description: Create test suite that runs same queries against both implementations and compares results. Use queries from js/Cypher.test.js.bak.
